name: Soyu
source:
Department of Biotechnology; Holstein Friesian

An undergrad who's pretty much always asleep. She doesn't wake up when I try waking her, yet she's somehow able to work.

The times she's actually awake are extremely short, yet she's a rather odd undergrad who's somehow able to fit the same amount of work as everyone else into that short time.
